summary: Architectural plan to migrate server-side full-collection scans (Reading Shelf, trackBook deduplication, Unified Catalog Search, and listBooks filters) to native Firestore single-field indexed queries, introduce deterministic normalized index fields (cleanIsbn, dedupeKey, searchTokens) with a Shelf Care index backfill and unindexed fallback, and upgrade the Web Worker fuzzy duplicate detector to use multi-key blocking instead of an O(N^2) format loop.
